summary.text: Annabel Sutherland took 4 for 30 as Australia Women restricted BANW to 166-10, despite Ritu Moni scoring 45 off 63 balls. Phoebe Litchfield then hit 77 off 57 balls to guide Australia Women to 168-3 in 3 wickets.
